column1: # GLSL shaders Timespinner's MojoShader writes at run time (the Mac host's DM_GL_CAPTURE, booting into the first scene): its glsl120 translation of the game's 12 XNA effects
# (Content/Effects/*.xnb, Direct3D 9 bytecode, one pixel shader each) and of SpriteBatch's built-in effect (its vertex and pixel shader); <key>.vert / <key>.frag, key = sha256(GLSL)[:16].
# The NSP script's GL shader capture runs until every one here is captured; gl_shaders.py translates the capture
